nameEn: Manufacture of other food products n.e.c.
description: This class includes the manufacture of a variety of food products not elsewhere classified.
includes: manufacture of artificial honey and caramel
manufacture of perishable prepared foods such as sandwiches and fresh pizza
manufacture of food supplements and dietetic food
manufacture of eggs products: dried, powdered, frozen eggs
manufacture of extracts and juices of meat, fish, crustaceans or molluscs
manufacture of salt: sea salt, rock salt
manufacture of sauces, condiments and seasonings
manufacture of homogenized food preparations and dietetic food
excludes: manufacture of prepared animal feeds, see 1080
manufacture of chocolate and confectionery, see 1073
